senses.gloss: ch.<cite ref="N00239">same</cite> <cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 30:3">Targ. Num. XXX, 3</cite>; a. fr.—
units: <cite ref="Nedarim 22a:2">Ned. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>אילו הוה ידעת … מי נַדְרַת</he> if thou hadst known …, wouldst thou have vowed? <cite ref="Nedarim 22b:9">Ib. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>נדרת אדעת דהכי</he> wouldst thou have made the vow, if thou hadst known this.
<cite ref="Nedarim 22b:10">Ib.</cite> <he>לא נַדְרִי</he> I should not have vowed.
<cite ref="Nedarim 9a:2">Ib. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>לא נְדרְנָא</he> I will not vow; a. v. fr.

senses.gloss: as preced. Hif. Ib. 21ᵇ דאַדַּרְתָּהּ לברתה who forbade her daughter all benefits from her. Ib. 24ᵃ אַדְּרֵיה מזמנא וכ׳ the host urged the guest with a vow; אדריה זמינא וכ׳ the guest caused the host to invite him with a vow. Ib. 22ᵃ מי אדרתה wouldst thou have forbidden her? Gitt. 36ᵃ דאַדְּרֵיה ר׳ אחא whom R. A. forbade to teach.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 70b:4">Keth. 70ᵇ</cite> <he>אַדַּרְתָּן</he> thou hast put me under restrictions; a fr.
